summary_markdown: The discussion focused on the timing and method for updating ClickHouse. Initially, [p1] suggested an immediate update. Both participants agreed that performing the update on a Saturday would be preferable to allow time to troubleshoot potential issues if the nightly job fails. The consensus was reached to schedule the update for the following Saturday. It was also discussed whether a server-level update was possible; however, it was advised against doing so, especially when planning for a weekend deployment.
decisions: The ClickHouse update will be scheduled for the following Saturday.
